limitations: Self-selected, historical app-store reviews; not representative of all users.
Only 236894 [K02] of 660622 [K01] records were classified. 423728 [K03] were quarantined, mostly as outside the declared classification scope (422667 [K06]).
Exact-text reuse accounts for 159552 [K05] completed records, which share one model label, so duplicates may inflate counts.
Cancellation language is expressed intent, not churn. No revenue or causal estimates are made.
The ranking is by volume x severity, so low-volume, high-severity areas such as access rank lower.
memo.recommendation: Under the baseline rule (priority_score = complaint_count x mean_severity), the generic "other.general" issue ranks first at 78701 [C04], but it is not a product area. Among specific areas, billing_support has the highest severity sum at 23467 [T15], and its top issue, free tier limits and paywalled features, scores 18916 [C08]. Usability is second at 30785 [T09] by area sum, but that is mostly driven by ads (16481 [C12]). I recommend billing_support, with usability ads as the runner-up.

supporting_evidence.point: Free-tier restrictions rank 2 overall with 6975 complaints [C05] and a priority score of 18916 [C08].
Billing_support has the most cancellation mentions of any area at 1924 [T14], and mean severity of 2.674912 [T16]. This is expressed intent only, not observed churn.
Ads interruptions rank 3 with a score of 16481 [C12], so there is a related free-tier experience theme.
